description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for user registration in a C# ASP.NET Core project. It includes the command pattern, validation, and handler logic for creating a new user, ensuring username and email uniqueness, hashing passwords, and generating JWT tokens.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: A feature class encapsulating the user creation process, including command definition, validation, and handler logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the user creation command: checks for existing username and email, hashes the password, saves the new user to the database, and generates a JWT token.
